platform_constraints: Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN + vanilla JS (no framework)
Vercel serverless functions (api/orders.js) with Upstash Redis
Google Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (display) + Inter (body)
Mobile-first responsive (no SSR, pure static HTML)
Order polling interval: 1.5s (existing pattern in index.html)

proven_sources.name: api/orders.js Backend
proven_sources.why_proven: REST API: GET (list all), POST (create with antrian counter), PATCH (status update with validation), DELETE (clear finished/all). Status flow: Dipesan→Diterima→Disiapkan→Siap Diambil→Selesai. 32 unit tests in test/orders.test.js.

exact_code_recipes.feature: Merchant Dashboard POS — Live Order Card Component
exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: Render order cards in a responsive grid (1-col mobile, 2-col tablet, 3-col desktop). Each card fetches from GET /api/orders, filtered by status tab. Quick-action PATCH buttons advance status. Sound notification on new order arrival (Web Audio API or <audio> tag).

exact_code_recipes.source_url: index.html (existing filter pills: Semua, Minuman, Makanan)
exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: Add filter tabs above order grid. Active filter applies class 'bg-espresso text-white', inactive applies 'bg-white text-espresso border border-gray-200'. Filter logic: check order.status against tab key. Reuses exact same toggle pattern as index.html menu filters.

Call playOrderChime() inside the polling interval (every 1.5s) when new order detected (order count increased). Gate with a 'soundEnabled' toggle stored in localStorage. First user interaction required to unlock AudioContext (browser policy).

Compute stats from order list: 'Pesanan Baru' (status=Dipesan), 'Sedang Disiapkan' (status=Disiapkan), 'Siap Diambil' (status=Siap Diambil), 'Selesai Hari Ini' (status=Selesai). Update on each poll cycle. Reuse exact same card styling: bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 border border-gray-100 shadow-sm.

Wire PATCH call to existing api/orders.js endpoint. Button appears at bottom-right of each order card. On click: PATCH status → reload order list → play chime if status changed to 'Siap Diambil'. Reuse exact same PATCH pattern from penjual.html.

Replace entire penjual.html body content. Keep same <head> with Tailwind CDN and Google Fonts. Maintain same API_URL constant and polling interval. Background: bg-[#F0F9FF] (lightest sky from machi palette). All rounded corners: rounded-3xl (Machi standard). All shadows: shadow-sm.

covered_patterns.notes: Current penjual.html uses orange theme, basic order list. Needs full redesign to match Machi cold brew aesthetic with live order cards, status filter tabs, sound notification, stat summary, quick actions.
Status badge system exists in index.html modal. Merchant portal needs same status colors but as card badges + quick-action buttons.
